title: Particle emitters
doc: Particle emitter types used by explosions, level emitters and other effects.

sections.name: #particle emitter types
sections.doc: List of emitter types; each starts at $name: and the list ends at #end.

fields.name: $name:
fields.doc: Unique emitter name.

fields.name: $pos:
fields.doc: Emitter position relative to its parent.

fields.name: $dir:
fields.doc: Main emission direction (normalised by the game).

fields.name: $dir_rand:
fields.doc: Spread around the direction; -1 emits in every direction.

fields.name: $min_vel:
fields.doc: Lowest starting speed of a particle.

fields.name: $max_vel:
fields.doc: Highest starting speed of a particle.

fields.name: $spawn_radius:
fields.doc: Radius of the sphere particles start in.

fields.name: $min_spawn_delay:

children.name: $max_spawn_delay:
children.doc: Longest time between two particles; read only after $min_spawn_delay:.

fields.doc: Shortest time between two particles.

fields.name: $emitter_flags:
fields.doc: Emitter options; the game looks for each option name inside the quoted text, so any separator works.

fields.name: $initially_on:
fields.doc: Whether the emitter starts emitting.

fields.name: $alternate_states:
fields.when: children read only when the value is true

children.name: $on_time_variance:
children.doc: Random variation of the on time.

children.name: $off_time_variance:
children.doc: Random variation of the off time.

fields.doc: Whether the emitter switches on and off by itself.

fields.name: $min_life_secs:
fields.doc: Shortest particle life.

fields.name: $max_life_secs:
fields.doc: Longest particle life.

fields.name: $min_pradius:
fields.doc: Smallest particle radius.

fields.name: $max_pradius:
fields.doc: Largest particle radius.

fields.name: $growth_rate:
fields.doc: How fast particles grow (negative shrinks).

fields.name: $acceleration:
fields.doc: Acceleration along the travel direction (negative slows).

fields.name: $gravity_scale:
fields.doc: Multiplier on gravity for particles with the gravity flag.

fields.name: $bitmap:
fields.doc: Particle image: a bitmap, or a .vbm animation.

fields.name: $particle color:
fields.doc: Starting tint {r, g, b, a}.

fields.name: $particle color dest:
fields.doc: Tint at the end of the life (used with clr_change).

fields.name: $particle flags:
fields.doc: Particle options; the game looks for each option name inside the quoted text (so collide also matches collide_liquid).

fields.name: $bounciness:
fields.doc: Bounce strength for colliding particles.

fields.name: $stickiness:
fields.doc: Chance of sticking to what a colliding particle hits.

fields.name: $swirliness:
fields.doc: Amount of random swirl.

fields.name: $damage_factor:
fields.doc: Damage dealt by particles with the damages flag.

fields.name: $age_pct_to_finish_vbm:
fields.doc: Fraction of the life over which a .vbm animation plays once.
